cards.front: Recall a key point about Complex Numbers
cards.back: Cartesian form: z = a + bi; Polar form: z = r(cos θ + i sin θ) = re^{iθ}

cards.front: Recall a key point about Complex Numbers
cards.back: Modulus |z| = sqrt(a^2+b^2); Argument arg(z) = arctan(b/a) (adjust for quadrant)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Complex Numbers
cards.back: Conjugate: z̄ = a - bi = re^{-iθ}; Properties: z + z̄ = 2a, z z̄ = |z|^2

cards.front: Recall a key point about Complex Numbers
cards.back: de Moivre: (cos θ + i sin θ)ⁿ = cos nθ + i sin nθ; (re^{iθ})ⁿ = rⁿe^{inθ}

cards.front: Recall a key point about Complex Numbers
cards.back: n-th roots: r^{1/n} e^{i(θ+2kpi)/n} for k = 0,1,...,n-1 (n distinct roots)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Complex Numbers
cards.back: Complex roots of real polynomials occur in conjugate pairs

cards.front: Recall a key point about Complex Numbers
cards.back: Loci: |z - a| = r (circle), arg(z - a) = α (half-line), |z - a| = |z - b| (perp bisector)

cards.front: Recall a key point about Complex Numbers
cards.back: Euler's formula: e^{iθ} = cos θ + i sin θ; cos θ = ½(e^{iθ}+e^{-iθ}), sin θ = (e^{iθ}-e^{-iθ})/(2i)
